messages:
maria: quick sync — 11:00 PST change window starts in ~40m. Canary plan is 5% traffic for 15m then promote if healthy. Need confirmation on rollback rules and model/runtime pin. @jay @sre-oncall

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Received canary deploy request for service=api. Image=redwood/api:v2.9.1-canary. Target=5% traffic for 15m. To approve for promote: `/deploy approve 1848123450` — or visit https://deploy.redwood.internal/1848123450

jay: I ran load checks earlier — p95 latency looks good on beefy nodes. Main risk is embeddings DB connection under high concurrency. Propose rollback if 5xx rate >0.5% sustained for 5m. Also pin runtime to 1.14.2 to avoid jit regressions. @maria can you add that to release notes?

alex: Rollback playbook excerpt:
```
# emergency rollback
curl -X POST "https://controller.internal/rollbacks" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"service":"api","target":"v2.8.9-optimized"}'
```
Use this if canary causes error spike or token cost jumps.

samira: Checklist I'm running through now:
1) pin routing to runtime=1.14.2
2) enable slowstart scaling (to avoid thundering herd)
3) warm K/V caches
4) set alert thresholds: 5xx>0.5% / p95>1.2s / token_cost +20%
5) disable aggressive autoscale for first 30m
I'll kick off cache warm: `./scripts/warm_cache.sh --keyset=common-prompts` and post when done.

sre-oncall: Oncall watching. Runbook open: if 5xx>0.5% for 5m OR p95>1.2s for 10m OR token cost delta >20% => rollback. We'll page at step start. Also enabling Dedicated fallback route to v2.8.9-optimized as safety net.

jay: Also ensure the canary has reduced concurrency cap (max_concurrency=50) — if it hits limit we fallback to stable.

maria: Updating release_notes.md now: runtime_pin=1.14.2; rollback_criteria=5xx>0.5%_5m|p95>1.2s_10m|token_cost>20%; fallback=v2.8.9-optimized. Adding deploy links and the commands above.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary started at 1848123500. Logs: https://logs.redwood.internal/streams/1848123500

alex: Quick manual rollback command if needed locally:
`./deploy-tools rollback --service api --target v2.8.9-optimized`

maria: OK — if no objections I will promote after 15m hold. :thumbsup:

jay: :thumbsup:

samira: :white_check_mark: I'll watch the dashboards and confirm on completion.
